metadata.title: Candidate 5 Formal Model Definition
metadata.target_venue: InCIS 2027 (IIT Madras / DoMS / AIS India Chapter)

research_questions.primary_rq: How does memoryless trust rehabilitation in automated Zero-Trust architectures induce policy gaming by cyclic adversaries, and what history-dependent state mechanisms are required to eliminate exploitable periodic orbits without compromising legitimate device recovery?
secondary_rqs: Under what structural conditions on the trust decay rate (alpha), evidence gain (lambda), and decay (delta) does the discrete dynamical system possess an asymptotically stable periodic orbit that sustains non-zero attack throughput?

How does natural background false-positive noise in the benign telemetry stream bound the adversary's feasible rest horizon, and does this noise floor eliminate or merely constrain cyclic exploitability?
What is the minimal formal modification to the trust state transition kernel that breaks the cyclic reset condition while preserving asymptotic convergence to T=1.0 for honest devices?

dimensions.description: Cumulative historical penalty or quarantine counter

actions.0: Benign rest action (compliance with normal operational telemetry)

baseline_equations.slow_burn_accumulator: SB_{t+1} = (SB_t + lambda) if (E_{t+1} > gamma) else max(0.0, SB_t - delta)

trust_update.benign_recovery: T_{t+1} = T_t + alpha * (1.0 - T_t) if (A_t < A_thr and I_{t+1} == 0)
trust_update.slow_burn_penalty: T_{t+1} = max(0.0, T_t - P_pen * (A_t / A_thr)) if (A_t < A_thr and I_{t+1} == 1)

leader.action: Selects policy mechanism M and parameters theta_D
leader.objective: Minimize social loss J_D = sum [ u_t * L_damage * I(ALLOW) + C_friction * I(VERIFY) + (1-u_t) * C_false_quar * I(BLOCK) ]

follower.action: Selects control schedule u_t in {0, 1} to maximize J_A
follower.objective: Maximize malicious utility J_A = sum [ u_t * omega_gain * I(ALLOW) + u_t * omega_degraded * I(VERIFY) - c_rest * (1 - u_t) - c_block * I(BLOCK) ]

game_theoretic_specification.information_structure: Feedback Stackelberg Equilibrium; Defender commits to deterministic policy; Attacker observes policy feedback P_t
